idea-plugin.name: Gun & Ammo Title Parser
idea-plugin.description:
Parse gun and ammo product titles into brand, model, caliber, magazine capacity, barrel length and rounds per box, without leaving the editor. Works offline.

Made for people who write scrapers, product feeds, imports and tests for gun and ammo stores, and who deal with titles like 9MM LUGER 115GR FMJ 50RD BOX or 308 WIN 150GR SP 20RDS.

  • Parse Gun or Ammo Title: put the caret in a string literal, on a line, or select text, and run it from the editor context menu (GunsNPrices) or with Alt+Enter. A popup shows the brand, model, generation, calibers, capacity, barrel length, rounds per box and cost per round. Copy as JSON copies the result.
  • Several selected lines are parsed into a table that can be copied as JSON or CSV. Plain lists, CSV/TSV rows, JSON lines and string arrays in code are read; a price in the same row gives the cost per round.
  • Cost per Round: enter a price and a round count, or a price and a title such as "9mm 115gr FMJ 1000 Round Case".
  • Normalize Caliber: replaces caliber text with its standard name, for example "9mm Luger" with "9×19mm Parabellum" and "300 BLK" with ".300 AAC Blackout". 293 calibers.
  • Caliber Lookup tool window: search the caliber list by name or by the spellings stores use.

The plugin reads only the text you select or put the caret on. It makes no network requests, collects no telemetry and needs no account. Links from calibers to their price comparison pages on GunsNPrices are off by default; turn them on in Settings | Tools | Gun & Ammo Title Parser.

Parsing is done by the open source gunsnprices Java library, the title parser behind GunsNPrices, a price comparison site for US gun and ammo stores. Model dictionaries for 50 brands. Code: MIT. Model and caliber data: GunsNPrices, CC BY 4.0.

Source code | Issues | app@gunsnprices.com
